opportunities.name: United flight search by origin, destination, and dates
opportunities.description: Search one-way or round-trip flights on united.com by entering an origin airport, a destination, departure and optional return dates, traveler count and cabin, then clicking Find flights.
steps: Open the United homepage Book tab (Flight).
Select Roundtrip or One-way.
Click the From field, clear it, type the origin city or airport code, and pick the matching suggested search entry.
Click the To field, type the destination, and pick the suggested entry (prefer the 'All Airports' option when offered).
Click the Dates field, navigate the calendar to the departure month, click the departure date, then (for round trips) navigate to the return month and click the return date.
If needed, open the Travelers dropdown and set adult/child counts with the + and - buttons.
If needed, change the cabin dropdown (Economy, Premium economy, Business or First).
Click Find flights.

opportunities.name: SpotHero event parking search and booking
opportunities.description: Find parking near a sports or entertainment venue for a chosen event date by searching the venue, choosing the event, setting entry and exit times, optionally applying an accessibility filter, updating the search and choosing a listing.
steps: Click the search box on the SpotHero homepage, type the venue name, and choose the matching suggestion.
In the venue events dialog, click Select Event Date and pick the event date in the calendar (if needed).
Click the event listed under that date.
On the results page, click the Enter After time field and set the entry time; click the Exit Before time field and set the exit time.
Optionally click Filter and tick the required option (for example Wheelchair Accessible), then click Show N Results.
Click Update Search.
Click Book Now on the chosen parking listing.

instances.values: Venue Barclays Center, event Orlando Magic at Brooklyn Nets Apr 7 2023, entry time 5:30 PM changed to 3:00 PM, exit time 11:30 PM changed to 5:00 PM, Update Search then Book Now on 201 S Portland Ave listing.

opportunities.name: Tripadvisor restaurant search by destination with cuisine filter
opportunities.description: Search Tripadvisor for a destination, open its restaurants list, apply a cuisine filter and open a restaurant.
steps: Click the Where to? search box on the Tripadvisor homepage.
Type the destination (city or landmark) and choose the matching suggestion.
Click the Restaurants tab or link on the destination page.
In the left filter panel, expand Cuisine (More) and tick the desired cuisine in the modal, then click Apply.
Open the first matching restaurant from the results list.

instances.values: Destination Central Park New York, Restaurants list, cuisine filter Italian applied with Apply.
Destination Los Angeles, Restaurants list, cuisine filter Indian applied, then Urban Masala opened and Order online clicked.
